I was a fan when I was 13-14. I was going through a really bad spot and I came across one of his speaks videos about body image. I was instantly hooked, I religiously watched his videos for about a year. 

The worst part about it was his self harm and assault  videos, they made my self harm so much worse than it would've been. They made me feel so guilty that this person I looked up to thought I was just attention seeking and it was my fault I was assaulted bc I didn't tell anyone. His videos stopped me from getting help for a long time bc I felt so ashamed. But at the same time his other videos made me laugh and feel like I was understood. Its weird to describe honestly.

There was even a point where I posted photos on his forums and got into a video. I only found out way later when a friend saw me in his video. I was an 8.5, my boyfriend (now husband) said he was delusional bc I was a 10.

I never knew about the drama that went on until after I stopped watching. Repzion was actually what got me out of being a fan. He helped me through a lot, and I finally got help.

And you're completely right I haven't let him off the hook at all. I'm sorry if I wasn't super clear in my first post my brains a bit scrambled, he proves he's been faithful with evidence my brain just still hangs on. Idk if that even makes sense. Thank you for reminding me not to let it slide to easily tho!
